name: d3-sankey
purpose: Unmodified upstream UMD of the D3 Sankey layout, over the d3 bundle (d3.min, d3.max, d3.sum, d3.linkHorizontal), for the native DOM and paint differential fixtures; test dependency only
modifications: None: copied original bytes from package tarball
build_options: No build. Load the checked-in d3-sankey.js UMD directly as a source script after third_party/d3/d3.js, whose d3-array and d3-shape it uses (its package names d3-array 1 - 2 and d3-shape ^1.2.0; d3 7.9.0 bundles d3-array 3 and d3-shape 3, whose min, max, sum and linkHorizontal it calls alike); normal builds require no network.
